title.zh_CN: 毕业答辩 · 另一条路

text.zh_CN: 答辩大厅很安静。大屏幕上回放着你在远望的完整记录：第一笔成交、第一笔股息、利率冲击、做空、期权与杠杆，直到 32 个单元全部结业。你目前没有在管理的基金，但每一笔自己的交易，你都走完了。
text.en: The defense hall is quiet. The screen replays your complete record at Farview: first fill, first dividend, rate shocks, shorting, options, leverage, all the way through 32 units. You are not managing a fund right now, but you saw every one of your own trades through.

text.zh_CN: 答辩大厅很安静。大屏幕上回放着你在远望的完整记录：第一笔成交、第一笔股息、利率冲击、做空、期权与杠杆，直到 32 个单元全部结业。你曾经管理过一只基金，但它已经结束；现在，你重新回到自己的账户前。
text.en: The defense hall is quiet. The screen replays your complete record at Farview: first fill, first dividend, the rate shock, shorts, options and leverage, all the way through 32 units. You once ran a fund, but it is closed now; today you stand before your own account again.

text.zh_CN: 七年前，我管理的旧基金在这里清盘。外面一直说我输给了市场。其实我输给的，是那个以为看对了方向就能扛住一切的自己。今天我站在这儿，不是要你复制我的路，而是想看你带着这条教训往下走。
text.en: Seven years ago, the old fund I managed was liquidated here. People still say I lost to the market. What I really lost to was the self that believed a correct call was enough to endure anything. I stand here today not to make you copy my path, but to see you carry that lesson forward.

text.zh_CN: 台下的顾言安静地听着。他没有再争，只朝你点了点头。
text.en: In the audience, Gu Yan listens quietly. He does not argue; he simply gives you a small nod.

text.zh_CN: 你完成了全部 32 个单元，也证明了自己能按规则活下来。远望学院准予你毕业。接下来，你想把这段经验用在什么地方？
text.en: You completed all 32 units and proved you can survive by your own rules. Farview grants you graduation. Where do you want to put that experience next?

text.zh_CN: 【学院导师】留在远望任教，把风险纪律传给下一届学徒。
text.en: [Academy Mentor] Stay at Farview and teach risk discipline to the next cohort.

toast.zh_CN: 毕业去向：成为远望交易学院导师

text.zh_CN: 【独立交易员】带着自己的账户继续上路，在真实市场里验证这套方法。
text.en: [Independent Trader] Take your own account into the real market and test what you've learned.

toast.zh_CN: 毕业去向：成为独立交易员

text.zh_CN: 愿意把自己踩过的坑讲给别人听，比独自赚钱更难。远望的讲台，从今天起有你一个位置。
text.en: Telling others about the mistakes you survived is harder than making money alone. There is a place for you at Farview's podium.

text.zh_CN: 现在没有基金，没有客户，只有你自己的账户。那就用结果说话。
text.en: No fund, no clients now — just your own account. Let the results speak.

text.zh_CN: 答辩委员会一致通过。祝贺你，交易员。愿你记住：先活下来，再谈收益。
text.en: The committee affirms with unanimous consent. Congratulations, trader. Remember: survive first, then talk returns.
